subject: Evidence Handoff & SSO/Encryption Deep Dive — slot coordination
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice@helmcloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: security@helmcloud.com, Frank Li <frank.li@helmcloud.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC2 evidence + SSO/encryption deep dive

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Thanks for agreeing to help. We need a focused technical review to hand off SOC 2 evidence and walk through SSO, key management, and audit log retention. Procurement has also flagged that they want a clear evidence list for our compliance pack.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Sep 7, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Sep 8, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Sep 9, 09:00–10:00

Agenda we had in mind:
- Quick introductions (5m)
- SSO integration (SAML/OIDC) and session flows (20m)
- Encryption at rest / KMS configuration (15m)
- Audit logs: retention, format, and evidence exports (10m)
- Artifact list & handoff next steps (10m)

Can you confirm who from Redwood should join for the architecture bits and whether you can provide a preliminary artifact index before the call? Also, procurement will want a DocuSign at the end, so any point of contact for that would help.

Thanks,
Alice
--
Alice Wu
Security Program Manager, HelmCloud
alice@helmcloud.com

Date: 2026-08-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 evidence + SSO/encryption deep dive

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear agenda. We can run this and have the right folks on the call. Proposed participants from Redwood:
- Soojin Lee, Security PM (me) — facilitation and artifact questions
- Karthik Iyer, Solutions Engineer — SSO & integration walkthrough
- Evelyn Hart, Security Engineer — KMS/encryption details and audit logs
- Diego Fernandez, Customer Success — procurement & post-call follow-ups

Our availability (PST):
- Tue Sep 7, 10:00–11:00 — OK for the team
- Wed Sep 8, 14:00–15:00 — Diego is booked but others can join
- Thu Sep 9, 09:00–10:00 — OK but Evelyn prefers morning

Can we lock Tue Sep 7 10:00–11:00 unless HelmCloud prefers a different slot?

Prework we can provide before the call:
- SOC2_evidence_index.pdf — index of artifacts we typically share
- redwood-artifact-mapping.xlsx — proposed mapping to your control framework
- sso-flow-diagram.png — high-level SAML/OIDC flow (handy for the call)

If procurement needs a DocuSign template, Diego will own that handoff. If you can share a short list of required artifacts (e.g., KMS configs, rotation policies, log exports), we’ll pre-stage them.

Best,
Soojin

soojin@redwood.com

Soojin — Tue Sep 7 10:00–11:00 works for us. Confirming attendees from HelmCloud: myself (Security PM), Frank Li (Infra Lead), and security@helmcloud.com (central compliance alias).

Procurement note: they asked for a short artifact checklist ahead of time — top priority items are:
- KMS key IDs and rotation policy
- SSO metadata and assertion details (SAML metadata or OIDC discovery)
- Example audit log export for a 30-day window
- SOC2 type II attestation doc (if available)

We’d appreciate the mapping sheet before the call; it speeds procurement review. Once the call is complete and procurement is satisfied, we’ll need a DocuSign for the standard DPA addendum. Can Diego be the DocuSign contact?

Thanks — I’ll accept the invite once you send it.

— Alice
